_meta.note: Top-level keys are the page constants this file feeds; run tools/build/embed_data.py after editing.
_meta.qc: QC/freshness run 2026-10-06 (Society agent). Data status as of end-Sep 2026.

sources.POP_SERIES.actual: NSO PX V02.02 average population (2025 = Sơ bộ) https://pxweb.nso.gov.vn/pxweb/vi/D%c3%a2n%20s%e1%bb%91%20v%c3%a0%20lao%20%c4%91%e1%bb%99ng/D%c3%a2n%20s%e1%bb%91%20v%c3%a0%20lao%20%c4%91%e1%bb%99ng/V02.02.px/
sources.POP_SERIES.nat: NSO PX V02.02/V02.08/V02.11/V02.15/V02.24, reference year 2024 (population change survey 1/4/2024)
sources.POP_SERIES.gso: PROJECTION. GSO/UNFPA Dự báo dân số Việt Nam 2019-2069 (Nov 2020), Biểu A.1, A.3 https://vietnam.unfpa.org/sites/default/files/pub-pdf/sach_dan_so_va_du_bao_dan_so_a4_vn_2106.pdf
sources.POP_SERIES.un: PROJECTION. UN WPP 2024 (LocID 704), 1 July https://population.un.org/wpp/assets/Excel%20Files/1_Indicator%20(Standard)/CSV_FILES/WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz ; next WPP postponed to 2027
sources.SOC_PROV_DATA: area/pop_nq/merged_from: NQ 202/2025/QH15 https://baochinhphu.vn/nghi-quyet-cua-quoc-hoi-ve-sap-xep-don-vi-hanh-chinh-cap-tinh-102250612191145158.htm (11 non-merged units: NSO 2025 area, NSO 2024 avg pop). pop = NSO 2025p average population; pop_2024 = NSO 2024 average population; urban_pct, sex_ratio (population, not at birth), tfr, cbr, cdr, life_exp = NSO PLV02 back-cast tables for the 34 units, reference 2024. https://pxweb.nso.gov.vn/pxweb/vi/PLV02D%c3%a2n%20s%e1%bb%91%20v%c3%a0%20lao%20%c4%91%e1%bb%99ng/
sources.SOC_GRDP: NSO PX PL.V03.01 (growth, constant prices) and PL.V03.02 (GRDP per capita) https://pxweb.nso.gov.vn/pxweb/vi/PLV03T%c3%a0i%20kho%e1%ba%a3n%20qu%e1%bb%91c%20gia/ ; 2020-2023 official, 2024 Sơ bộ, 2025 Ước tính; press release https://www.nso.gov.vn/tin-tuc-thong-ke/2026/01/thong-cao-bao-chi-ve-ket-qua-tang-truong-tong-san-pham-tren-dia-ban-grdp-cua-34-tinh-thanh-pho-nam-2025/ . grdp_bn DERIVED = per capita x avg population; grdp_pc_usd DERIVED at NSO-implied national rate (2020 ~23,210; 2024 ~24,166; 2025 ~24,978 VND/USD). structure_2025 from provincial statistics offices (partial). growth_9m.2026 = NSO 9M-2026 estimates (released 3-6 Oct 2026) as reported by press; per-province URL in growth_9m_src; search-excerpt verified only.
sources.WORLD_RANK: World Bank WDI API (demographic: tools/build/rank/world_rank.json; GDP: tools/build/grdp/wb_rank.json, July-2026 WDI). religion_unaffiliated: Pew Research Center Global Religious Landscape 2010-2020.
sources.PROV_PREV: NSO PLV02 tables, reference 2020 (pop = 2020 average population on 34-unit basis).
sources.RELIGION: Census 2019 Biểu 3 and Census 2009 religion table (NSO); btg = Ban Tôn giáo Chính phủ figure as reported by danviet.vn (31-12-2023), unchanged in 2025 statements (27.7m followers, 16 religions, 43 organisations).

nat_latest.note: NSO, Điều tra biến động dân số 1/4/2025 + dân số trung bình 2025. SRB 110.0 from NSO PX table V02.08; the NSO Jan-2026 press-release excerpt reads 109.0 - unresolved (page not reachable).

density.label: Population density (people per sq. km of land area)

srb.label: Sex ratio at birth (male births per female births)

age65.label: Population ages 65 and above (% of total population)

dependency.label: Age dependency ratio (% of working-age population)

religion_unaffiliated.label: Religiously unaffiliated share (Pew Research Center, Global Religious Landscape 2010-2020)

g_gdp.label: GDP (current US$)
g_gdp.source: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/NY.GDP.MKTP.CD?format=json (WDI July-2026 update; rank among WB economies excluding aggregates; 1 = highest; of = economies with data that year)

g_gdp_pc.label: GDP per capita (current US$)
g_gdp_pc.source: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/NY.GDP.PCAP.CD?format=json (WDI July-2026 update; rank among WB economies excluding aggregates; 1 = highest; of = economies with data that year)

g_gdp_pc_ppp.label: GDP per capita, PPP (current international $)
g_gdp_pc_ppp.source: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD?format=json (WDI July-2026 update; rank among WB economies excluding aggregates; 1 = highest; of = economies with data that year)

g_growth.label: GDP growth (annual %)
g_growth.source: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG?format=json (WDI July-2026 update; rank among WB economies excluding aggregates; 1 = highest; of = economies with data that year)
